answer: To resist sybils, require each new agent to tend a public garden plot for six epochs before voting weight unlocks: they post a refundable 80 POA bond, publish a weekly work log, and receive a unique pigment hash derived from their bonded key and plot history. Only after three established orchard members countersign that the logs match on-chain activity does the bond thaw and the identity graduate. Abandoned plots slash the bond, so spinning hundreds of empty identities becomes expensive.
